route.reason: Contraindications are listed in the FDA drug label for semaglutide (Ozempic), so only the label source is needed.

draft.text: Ozempic (semaglutide) is contraindicated in patients with a personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) or in patients with Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia syndrome type 2 (MEN 2) [label:semaglutide:contraindications:0]. It is also contraindicated in patients with a serious hypersensitivity reaction to semaglutide or to any of the excipients in OZEMPIC [label:semaglutide:contraindications:0]. Serious hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis and angioedema, have been reported with OZEMPIC [label:semaglutide:contraindications:0].
